name: PJRC Teensy 4.1
mpn: TEENSY41 (with Ethernet PHY) / TEENSY41_NE (no Ethernet) / _PINS variants
description: 600 MHz NXP i.MX RT1062 Cortex-M7 board with 8 MB flash, microSD socket, Ethernet PHY and 55 I/O, 3.3 V logic.

specs.label: MCU
specs.value: NXP i.MX RT1062, Arm Cortex-M7 @ 600 MHz, FPU (32/64-bit)

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 1024 kB RAM (512 kB tightly coupled), 8 MB flash, 2 pads for optional QSPI PSRAM/flash

specs.label: Interfaces
specs.value: 8 serial, 3 SPI, 3 I2C, 3 CAN (1 CAN FD), 2 I2S, USB device + host (480 Mbit/s), 10/100 Ethernet PHY, SDIO microSD

specs.label: Voltage
specs.value: VIN/VUSB 5 V; I/O 3.3 V, not 5 V tolerant

envelope.axes: x = length (PCB, USB end to SD end), y = width, PCB 1.57 mm thick; USB adds 0.7 mm in x; total height not given

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: None. Mount by the pin rows: two 24-pin rows at 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm apart, 1.27 mm in from the long edges; first pin 1.27 mm in from the USB end. Finished holes Ø0.965 mm (59) and Ø0.762 mm (6).

features.label: USB connector
features.value: Micro-USB, 8.06 mm wide, overhangs the PCB edge by 0.7 mm, 5.0 mm deep, top 2.5 mm above the PCB (3.07 mm overall connector height)

features.label: Other features
features.value: Program button 41.66 mm from the USB end; Ethernet pads 6-pin (2.0 mm pitch) and USB-host 5-pin header on the board

amazon.title: PJRC Teensy 4.1 ARM Cortex-M7 Processor at 600MHz with a NXP iMXRT1062 (Without pins)

notes: The drawing's '17.78 ±0.6' tolerance is as published. Total height including the SD socket and bottom parts is not given. Several Amazon ASINs exist on the PJRC brand store: B088JY7P2H (no pins), B088D3FWR7 (no pins), B0BP5BNC9K (Ethernet + pins), B0CV221MF3 (no Ethernet). The pinout card PDFs are the closest thing to a datasheet; the processor reference manual is NXP's.
